new_findings.statement: The A-01 defect on the in-force path. After a change of strength days in a plan in force, an anchorless plane-asking slot prefers the plane among configurations the plan already uses and can take one the plan held only as an ACCESSORY; the MAIN then carries that accessory's dose state. Routes: (a) plans built with plane slots whose anchor keys are absent from the new template set (4->2, 5->2); (b) plans built without any plane slot (class NONE / NOVICE without a named exercise): slotsInForce is {}, strengthRules passes inForce {} (truthy) and buildTemplates assigns plane slots to the running beginner plan. Doses: barbell-overhead-press MAIN 3x7, 3x7, 2x7, 4x7 ... for 10 weeks under STRENGTH (range 4-6), 44 of 672 changes (named barbell lifts, full gym or barbell set, INT/EXP, 4->2 or 5->2 in week 1; without the rule FULL_B:2 stays bench-press); lat-pulldown MAIN 3x7 in running beginner plans under STRENGTH (6 of 64), 2x12 or 1x12 next to 3x8 or 2x12 under GENERAL (12 of 64). SQ4-C6 dose clause NOT MET; R6-POLICY-5 STRENGTH range left for 10 weeks.
